name: Nakhon Pathom

queries.query: Nakhon Pathom Thailand official cadastral parcel map GIS land department
queries.result: The official Nakhon Pathom Provincial Land Office was found. It identifies the provincial land office and links the national LandsMaps parcel-search service; no open Nakhon Pathom-specific parcel API or downloadable geometry was found in the bounded search.

queries.query: นครปฐม แผนที่แปลงที่ดิน กรมที่ดิน ระบบสารสนเทศภูมิศาสตร์ official
queries.result: Official Thai-language Nakhon Pathom Provincial Land Office and Department of Lands parcel-map pages were found. The national LandsMaps service is described as covering parcel positions nationwide, but the public catalog states API use requires a written authorization and Consumer-Key/Consumer-Secret; no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.
